# Rumindium PDF Tools

Free online PDF tools with no signup and no watermark: merge, split, extract pages, reorder, rotate, crop, compress,
repair, convert PDF to Word/Excel/images/HTML/PDF-A and back, OCR scans, add text and watermarks, page numbers,
protect and unlock with passwords, redact, e-sign and fill forms.

- Homepage: https://pdf.rumindium.id/
- All tools: https://pdf.rumindium.id/tools
- Every tool lives at https://pdf.rumindium.id/tools/<tool-id> (for example
  https://pdf.rumindium.id/tools/merge, https://pdf.rumindium.id/tools/compress,
  https://pdf.rumindium.id/tools/ocr).
- Files delete themselves after every job; job history keeps metadata only.
- Signed-in users get unlimited jobs; anonymous use is 15 jobs a day.
- Sitemap: https://pdf.rumindium.id/sitemap.xml
